services_heading: Complete Decorating Services Across Liverpool and Wirral
services_subhead: From interior bedroom makeovers to exterior home refreshes, we handle every painting and decorating job with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Professional interior repaints and full decorating schemes for living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens and bathrooms. We prep properly, use quality paints, and leave your home spotless.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Cladding
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior paints for fascia, soffits, doors and cladding. All surfaces prepared and primed to ensure long-lasting colour and protection.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Expert wallpaper hanging for any room, including difficult corners and period properties. Feature walls and bold patterns applied with precision.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Painting
services.desc: Bespoke painting of doors, skirting, shutters and custom joinery. Multiple undercoats and finishes to achieve a professional, long-lasting result.

services.title: Commercial Painting & Refurbishment
services.desc: Office, retail and hospitality redecorating completed to tight schedules. Minimal disruption, quality finish, and competitive rates for larger projects.

services.title: Specialist Finishes & Restoration
services.desc: Period property restoration, lime wash, specialist coatings and bespoke colour matching. Heritage techniques for listed buildings and conservation work.

about_pullquote: We treat every home like our own—proper prep, quality paint, no shortcuts.
about_para_1: Tatton Painters and Decorators has been transforming homes across Liverpool and Wirral for over 15 years. Starting with a small team and a reputation for honest work, we've grown by doing the job right: preparing surfaces properly, using quality materials, and respecting your home. Today we complete over 100 projects a year, from cosy family homes to period properties and commercial spaces.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we turn up when we say we will, we tidy up properly, and the finish lasts. We don't cut corners on prep work—that's where the difference between a good paint job and a great one is made. Whether it's a single room refresh or a full house redecoration, you'll work with experienced painters who care about the detail.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Homeowners Say About Tatton Painters

reviews.text: Brilliant job redecorating our lounge. Mark and his team were clean, professional and finished bang on schedule. They moved furniture, protected everything, and left no mess. Couldn't fault them. Already recommended to three neighbours.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Had our kitchen and hallway painted while we had building work going on. Could have been chaos but they worked around everything. Colour match was spot on and the prep work was thorough. Will definitely book them again for the bedrooms.
reviews.author: Emma T.

reviews.text: Got a free quote within two days and work started on the date promised. Two coats, proper undercoat on the woodwork, and the whole job finished in four days. Fair price and no hidden extras. Very happy.
reviews.author: James M.
